# Keep draft recovery accurate when users switch windows

## What & Why
The background-tab path now rechecks draft deadlines when visibility changes. Switching windows or minimizing the browser can also throttle timers, and that focus path should not let the visible recovery cue drift from the actual expiry deadline.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage switches focus away from an answer draft notice and then returns to it.
- The displayed recovery time never increases and the notice expires at the intended deadline.
- Opportunity drafts receive equivalent coverage where practical.
